name: Turntimber Sower
oracle_text:
Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token.
{G}, Sacrifice three creatures: Return target land card from your graveyard to your hand.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires when one or more cards matching a filter (here: land cards, owner = you, i.e. into YOUR graveyard) are put into a graveyard from ANY zone -- battlefield (sacrificed or destroyed lands), hand (discard), library (mill, surveil), stack -- with `batched: true` so one simultaneous move of several land cards (milling three lands) triggers once and makes one Plant
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no generic zone-change-to-graveyard event: leaves_battlefield with to_zones ["graveyard"] (the loader accepts to_zones on leaves_battlefield only) sees only permanents leaving the battlefield and misses milled and discarded land cards; discard covers only the hand; dies and sacrificed are battlefield-only; leaves_graveyard is the opposite direction. The create_token effect (plant_0_1_g exists) and the {G}, Sacrifice three creatures activated ability returning a target land card from your graveyard to hand are expressible today.
